tools.name: request_early_access
tools.description: Ask Handflow for real-world work done by verified people (starting in New York City). Describe the task, place and time. Handflow replies by email with up to 3 options and the total in USD.

tools.name: sign_up_to_earn
tools.description: Sign a person up to earn money doing real-world tasks with Handflow (starting in New York City). They set their own price and hours. Handflow emails them when there is work that fits.
